localHint: PDFs and notes stay on this device
search: Search titles, authors, tags or full text

importHint: Drop PDFs here or select multiple files
demoNotice: Sample papers and authors are fictional and demonstrate the workflow.
emptyHint: Import a PDF and leave your first reading note.
title: Title
name: Name

collectionEmpty: No papers in this collection yet

noTextHint: Read the file and take notes. Analysis needs OCR, which is not included yet.

evidenceHint: Analyze the paper to save pages, paragraphs and coordinates.
evidenceUnlinked: No locatable source is linked to this conclusion

questionHint: e.g. What limitations do the authors acknowledge?

questionNovelty: What method does this paper propose?
questionLimitation: What limitations do the authors acknowledge?
questionResults: What are the main experimental results?
quoteNotice: Related source excerpts. Review the surrounding context.
notePlaceholder: Your understanding, questions or research ideas…
noteDeleted: Note deleted and its PDF mark removed
notesLinkedHint: Click a highlighted passage or its margin marker to return to its notes.
noteUnsavedHint: You have unsaved changes. Keep editing, save and switch, or discard this draft.
noteQuotePlaceholder: What does this passage make you think of?
notesEmptyHint: Select text in the original to save a highlight or quote it in a note. You can also start a new note here.
deleteNoteHint: Delete this note? Its corresponding PDF mark will also be removed.
question: Question
notesHint: Notes are saved locally and separated from paper facts and model output.
translationNeedsModel: Translation requires a generation model. Original text is preserved.
translationHoverHint: Hover over a paragraph and select Translate paragraph.
translationReadingHint: Original typography stays intact. Translate only what you are reading.
translationWorking: Translating this paragraph. You can keep reading the original…
translationNoParagraphs: No translatable prose on this page. Figures and the original remain available.
readingTextUnavailable: Unable to load paragraphs. Please retry.
readingFocus: Hide sidebar to focus on reading
fieldSubtitle: Track evidence and methods around the same research question.
fieldEmptyHint: Add papers to a collection to explore relationships and comparisons.
noEdgesHint: Topic similarity alone does not establish citations or method lineage.
noEvolution: No verified evolution relationships; papers ordered by publication year.
compareHint: Select 2–4 papers. Empty fields mean unidentified, not absent from the paper.
conceptHint: Terms extracted from paper cards; this index does not establish technical relationships.
authorsSubtitle: Follow authors back to their papers and sources.
authorsEmpty: Researchers appear after importing papers with author metadata.
authorSource: Authors come from metadata. Advisor, student and employment relationships are not inferred.
settingsSubtitle: A workspace on your device that fits your reading habits.
appearanceHint: Theme and language preferences are saved in this browser.
modelUnconfigured: No remote model · local excerpt mode
modelConfigHint: Settings stay on this device; the API key never returns to the browser.
apiKeyKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current key
apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your model service API key
modelSecurityHint: Changes apply immediately. The key is written only to the local config file, never to the database or browser.
modelConnectionsHint: Keep official services and gateways side by side. Analysis, translation and questions use the active connection.
modelConnectionNameHint: For example: Official quota, Research, Backup gateway
modelNamePlaceholder: A model supported by this service
modelAutoFallback: Use backup connections when analysis hits a temporary failure
modelFallbackHint: Analysis and the AI librarian try backups in order for rate limits, interrupted connections and service failures, retrying only the current step. Translation and instant questions use the primary connection. Concurrent requests default to 1; busy connections prompt a retry.
modelChooseActive: No connection is active. Activate a saved connection to use models.
modelNoConnections: Add your first connection for full-paper analysis, translation and questions.
modelRouteSaved: Updated. Subsequent requests use this connection order.
modelDeleteConfirm: Delete this connection and its key? Deleting the active connection pauses subsequent model requests.
storageHint: PDFs, chunks, evidence and notes live in the local filesystem and SQLite.
exportHint: Export library metadata as JSON. PDF files remain on this device.
limitsHint: arXiv and DOI metadata enrichment and public PDF link imports are available. OCR, cloud sync and semantic search are not available; scanned PDFs need OCR first.
pdfvPassword: This PDF requires a password. Unlock it locally before importing.
pdfvInvalid: This PDF is invalid or damaged. Import the original file again.
pdfvMissing: The original PDF was not found. Check your local library.
pdfvNetwork: Unable to read the PDF. Check the local service and file address, then retry.
pdfvNoUrl: No original PDF file is available. Import a paper first.
pdfvCanvasError: The browser could not create a PDF canvas.
pdfvDestinationMissing: This section has no valid page destination.
pdfvDestinationUnsupported: This section uses an unsupported destination format.
pdfvScanned: This page has no selectable text and may be scanned or a figure page. It remains readable; text selection and search require OCR.
pdfvNoOutline: This PDF has no outline. Navigate by page number or full-text search.
pdfvLoadingHint: Reading the file and preparing pages…
pdfvSelectHint: Select source text to add a note or ask AI
summaryNeedsEvidence: Analyze the paper first. Without a model, this view contains only source excerpts.
selectionNoChunk: Select text within a single paragraph, then try again.
explainHint: Uses the selected passage and source context. Without a model, only context excerpts are shown.
importUrlTitle: Import a paper from a link
importUrlHint: Paste an arXiv paper page, arXiv PDF, or direct PDF link. The paper will be downloaded, identified, and saved to your Library.
downloadingPaper: Downloading the PDF and identifying the paper…
importUrlLocal: The PDF is saved locally. No model configuration is required. Maximum 50 MB per paper.
metadataPartial: Some details are unconfirmed. Open Paper details to view sources, identify again, or edit them.
metadataHint: Review bibliographic details and sources. arXiv years use the first submission date. Identify again preserves saved manual corrections.
metadataAuthors: Authors (one per line, in byline order)
metadataDiscardDraft: Identify again will discard unsaved edits. Saved manual corrections will be preserved.

librarianEmpty: Start with a precise research question
librarianNoPapers: No real papers in this scope
librarianNoPapersHint: Import papers or select a collection containing papers.

librarianQNotes: Which unresolved research questions appear in my notes?
librarianCoverageHint: Original text remains searchable for unanalyzed papers. Coverage depends on the available material.
librarianThreadHint: This conversation stays in this browser and resumes after opening a source.
semanticReview: Quote authenticity is checked; whether the source supports the claim still needs review.
requestStopped: Response stopped. Edit the question to try again.
scopeChanged: Scope changed. Ask using the new scope.
analysisUnavailable: Configure a remote model on the backend to enable intelligent analysis.
analysisImportHint: Analysis runs in the background after import. Reading and notes remain available.
analysisRemembered: Remembered on this device; you can change it for each batch.
importBatchHint: Review this batch and choose whether to analyze it with a remote model.
analysisBatchPartialError: Some papers were submitted for analysis. Unsubmitted papers remain selected so you can retry.
analysisReadingHint: Analysis runs in the background. The current card stays available while you read and take notes.
modelReadOnly: Model and quality settings are managed by the backend. API keys are never stored in the browser.
aiLocalHint: Local excerpts and AI analysis status are shown separately.
usagePartial: Some calls did not report usage
scienceReviewUnreviewed: Card entries not reviewed this time
scienceReviewNotProven: Scientific review does not prove scientific correctness.
sourceSectionsUnavailable: Original PDF sections could not be checked
sourceSectionsPreviousCard: Existing card uses previous section information
rejectionScienceSupport: Claim conditions or evidence are insufficient
